# Bioinformatics Series in Botswana

A capacity-building series in viral genomics, bioinformatics, AI, and data
science, hosted in Gaborone by the **Botswana Harvard Partnership (BHP)** with
partners across the African continent.

The series has two aims: build practical analytical skills among African
researchers, and harmonize the tools and workflows used across sites so that
results are comparable and outbreak response is faster.

---

The series is made possible by **SANTHE**, the **SANTHE–Gates Foundation
